reviews.text:
Good catch! Here’s the revised version:

We had a wonderful stay at Paradisus Palma Real. Everyone we encountered was friendly, welcoming, and eager to help. Our room was cleaned and restocked daily, which made our stay comfortable and stress-free.

The family side of the resort was perfect for us, especially with the Junior Swim-Up Suite. Having easy access to the pool was incredibly convenient and made traveling with a toddler so much easier.

The buffet offered a good variety of food and was best when we went earlier in the day. The specialty restaurants were excellent and were some of our favorite dining experiences during the trip. The concierge service was also extremely helpful, making restaurant reservations simple and ensuring everything went smoothly throughout our stay.

Overall, we had a fantastic vacation and would happily return. We highly recommend Paradisus Palma Real for families looking for a beautiful, relaxing, and family-friendly resort experience.
reviews.author: Hope Noelle

reviews.text: First time at the Paradisus Palma Real and had a very nice stay.  The property is well equipped and it is great that each building for guests has a dedicated pool independent from the main pool and beach area.  This gives you lots of options to just chill out or go hang out where music and activities are happening.  Overall the food was good, not excellent but good.  We stayed 10 days and had a very nice stay.  Would recommend the Paradisus if you are looking to get away for a relaxing vacation.
reviews.author: Christopher Paul

reviews.text: Todo muy limpio. No vi nada roto. Buena comida. Era mentira lo de los aires acondicionado. El nuestro funcionó de maravilla. Pero lo mejor de todo es el personal. NUNCA había visto a un equipo tan dedicado, tan sencillos, amables, serviciales. Quedé fascinado con todas esas personas. Los únicos inconvenientes de nuestro viaje no tuvieron nada que ver con el Hotel (BELLISIMO) o con su incrrible personal, fue el Zargazo que no nos permitió bañarnos en esa bella playa, pero el hotel no tiene culpa de eso.

reviews.text: This hotel was absolutely fabulous for our family holiday for 10 people. The food was incredible, room was spotless and gorgeous. The staff was so kind. The beach, pool, and activities were amazing. The only thing I’d improve, add a lift to the buildings, we had an elderly person with us who struggled using the stairs, also for accessibility for disabled visitors. Also I have a food allergy (dairy), and I let the hotel know and the staff members, but didn’t feel they really took it into consideration. I was given food that contained the item I was allergic to, even when I asked beforehand if this had dairy and was told no. I’d recommend adding some dairy free desserts. Otherwise, the food was incredible, especially the steak restaurant.

reviews.text:
Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real Punta Cana exceeded our expectations and became one of our favorite vacations. We stayed in The Reserve section and from arrival, everything felt effortless.

A special thank you to José, our bellman, who was exceptional from arrival to departure and always made us feel welcome. Our concierge, Christopher Rivera (Chris), truly made this vacation unforgettable. He arranged all of our dinner reservations, constantly checked on us, and made sure we had everything we needed. For my birthday, he helped my husband organize a private beach dinner with a special song playing—it honestly felt like a dream.

Special recognition also goes to Arismendi for making my birthday dinner extra special, Dilania at the pool area for always checking on us, Rafael at the beach for constantly going above and beyond, Carlos for my birthday drink, and Gladys for an incredible massage. Every employee made us feel like family.

Our beachfront walkout room was beautiful and fully stocked with everything we needed. The resort itself is luxurious, spacious, spotless, with plenty of beach chairs, pools, and a beautiful beach.

Brutally honest: we travel often and are hard to impress with food, but the buffet had great variety and authentic Dominican breakfast. Kanna, Asian, the steakhouse, and Italian restaurant were our favorites. Drinks were typical all-inclusive drinks. Nightlife is limited after 11 PM, but if relaxation is what you want, this place delivers.

reviews.text:
We travelled as couple, and this hotel is truly amazing. I can highly recommend it. We especially loved the beautiful beach, which, fortunately, is regularly cleared of seaweed by the hotel. The rooms are very spacious and exceptionally clean. There is also a great variety of pools, including an adults-only area. What impressed us the most was the food. We travel very frequently and have rarely experienced such a wide selection of restaurants offering excellent cuisine and extensive menus. There were also plenty of delicious options for vegetarians.
Furthermore, the staff is truly outstanding. We received a very warm welcome, and everyone took excellent care of us throughout our stay. Every request was handled quickly, professionally, and with genuine kindness. During our stay, I proposed to my girlfriend at the beautiful Kanna Beach at the hotel. To arrange everything, I contacted the hotel by email a few weeks in advance and explained my plans. My heartfelt thanks go to Jose R. and Leandro C. I initially planned everything with Jose via email — he took great care of every detail and made my wishes come true. Together with Leandro and an external company, they organized the decorations beautifully. It truly became the proposal of my dreams. Jose and Leandro also took exceptional care of us during our stay, especially considering the amount of coordination the proposal required.  Overall, our stay was absolutely wonderful, and we will definitely return!

reviews.text:
I stayed in the Reserve section for two nights. Although the amount I was ultimately charged did not match the amount I was told at check-in, I still think the upgrade was worth it. Since it was my first visit and I do not speak Spanish, having conceirge available to guide me through daily activities and programs was very helpful. Most staff members were kind and helpful. The adult-only pool was clean, relaxing, and not crowded. I also visited the family pool, which was larger and also looked very nice. As a solo traveler, I especially appreciated the calmer atmosphere.
The food was good and there were plenty of options. As a vegetarian with mushroom and eggplant allergies, I still had enough variety. I enjoyed breakfast and lunch at Santé and dinner at Blue Agave. Blue Agave had a lovely atmosphere, but the service there was disappointing. My plates were cleared twice while I was still eating, simply because I was typing on my phone. I asked about dessert options and was told churros & vanilla ice cream fritters. I asked for vanilla ice cream with churros, and after about 5 min I was told they only had chocolate ice cream. I had been there only around 40 minutes, the restaurant was nearly empty, and I felt rushed and unwelcome when I had hoped to enjoy my last evening.
My reservation included spa credit, but I was booked at Zel, so I couldnt use it. My personal concierge was great and arranged a jacuzzi bath both nights. I also enjoyed yoga, zumba, and bachata on the beach.
reviews.author: Mayuri

reviews.text:
Very disappointing experience at Paradisus Palma Real Golf & Spa Resort. For the amount of money paid, I expected luxury hospitality and professional management, but unfortunately my entire stay was stressful and unpleasant.

From the first night, management handled situations very poorly and staff were rude, dismissive, and unwelcoming throughout most of the trip. Security treated us in an extremely disrespectful way, and management did nothing meaningful to resolve the situation or make up for the experience.

Housekeeping also failed to clean our room on the first night even after we specifically requested it, which added to the frustration and is one of the reasons I rated cleanliness poorly.

The overall atmosphere of the hotel felt cold and uncomfortable rather than relaxing or luxurious. Aside from one helpful employee named Freddy, customer service across the resort was honestly terrible. Even when issues were brought to management’s attention multiple times, there was no real effort to improve our stay or compensate us for the problems we experienced.

This was supposed to be a relaxing vacation, but it ended up being one of the worst travel experiences I’ve had.

reviews.text:
The venue is absolutely gorgeous.   The beach is spectacular.   Food is wonderful.  I have been to this resort five times in eight years.     It’s hard not to go back when it is lovely and you feel very safe.  
However.    The service each time has went down and this time to such a degree that it does not make up for all of the beauty of the place.   Yes.  Some staff were very nice.   But the majority pay more attention to their colleagues than the vacationers.   Waited an hour and a half for ice because there are no ice machines and then being told you can get yourself at one of the restaurants.    I always upgrade to reserve for the butler.   Really all he does is make your reservations for your meals.   You can call ahead one week prior and do that yourself.     They use to do all kinds of small things and reserve your lounge chairs.   Put small snacks in your room before your dinner to snack on while getting ready with your favorite drink.   There seven days.   He did it twice with no drinks.  
My recommendation is if you want you are paying for pay a little

reviews.text:
Our stay at this all-inclusive resort was absolutely amazing from start to finish. The staff was incredibly welcoming, attentive, and always made us feel valued throughout the entire trip ( special Thank You for Danielle from Circle Melia Club), she made my vacation unforgettable. 
The resort itself was beautiful, clean, and very well maintained, with stunning views and a relaxing atmosphere everywhere we went.

Most importantly, the overall atmosphere was peaceful, luxurious, and perfect for a relaxing getaway. We truly felt taken care of the entire time. We would definitely come back again and highly recommend this resort to anyone looking for a fun, stress-free vacation experience.

reviews.text:
Let me start off by saying the resort itself is beautiful and amazing. Its not a disgusting resort and nasty. 
I went in just trying to relax and had low expectations but for some reason those low expectations became worse than I thought. I have been to multiple all inclusives, one in Punta Cana and I have never experienced worse service ever. We landed late and had a long flight of which we got there and got our wristbands/hotel keys. We were told we had a private concierge of which we were promised. We asked if we could make any dinner reservations of which he said we could not when we arrived because the reservation woman was not working. We carried all our luggage to our hotel room to find out our room keys weren't working so the concierge guy made us walk all the way with our backpacks back to the lobby to then get the key fixed to then walk all the way back to our room again. Im pretty low maintenance but the fact he went you had a long flight you guys should get some rest to making us lug our backpacks like 4 times rubbed me wrong. I told him the dinner reservations we wanted to make of which he told us he would make and he was going to text us on whats app. I never recieved a text at all and then the next morning we discovered we could make reservations on a tablet for our entire trip of which we found out he never made reservations for us. I asked the front lobby where

reviews.text: Beautiful setting, great pool, abundant lounges and beach front cabanas and umbrellas. The ocean water was truly a dream and the sand was incredibly soft. Food was decent, minimal complaints. The drinks were surprisingly fantastic- especially the bloody mary from the coffee bar and the pina colada from the sports bar! Shout out to those bartenders! The rooms were spacious and mostly clean. My only complaints: The A/C didn't do a very good job of dehumidifying anything and the room remained super humid. Because of this, the room also had a bit of a smell- a mix of mildew, feet, and smoke. It wasn't horrible and we adjusted fine after being in the room for a couple minutes. Overall we were super satisfied and we plan to go back

reviews.text:
Overall this resort was a pretty big disappointment.  The main area of the resort (lobby, courtyard, restaurant area) was very nice, scenic, clean and plenty of space to sit around and relax and enjoy the views.  There are plenty of bars with decent drinks and friendly bar tenders.  The staff was very nice and helpful.

The room however was very underwhelming and a pretty big disappointment.  We had the Junior Suite with the Ocean view.  The room had definitely seen better days.  Poorly patched holes and cracks in the walls, a very uncomfortable and stained couch, stains on the walls and furniture, and a pretty persistent mildew smell.  It just seemed run down and their solution was to paint over everything (they even painted over a stray hair on the furniture).  

Finding a spot at the beach was somewhat of a hassle if you didn’t get down early.  People would throw a towel down to claim a spot and not come back for hours, staff didn’t seem to enforce any of the 30 minute rules for leaving a space unattended.  Most of the beachfront is behind expensive cabanas that seemed to go entirely unrented, blocking the view and leading to the beach vendors using them to hang out and lounge on when they weren’t harassing people trying to relax on the beach.  

The food was by far the worst we’ve experienced.   Eating at the buffet was mostly just trying to find things that didn’t look like they would get you sick (we still got sick).  The actual restaurants were a little better.

reviews.text:
Fui com esposa e criança de 2 anos e meio, eles amaram e eu também. Voltaria. Calmo para um resort com bastante gente, deve ser porque é bem espaçoso. Praia de beleza indescritível. Quartos excelentes e comida fresca e muito saborosa. Pessoal excelente e em sua grande maioria simpático e atende bem.

Tive alguns incidentes que foram o unico motivo de não ser 5 estrelas para mim.

1. Com bebe me colocaram ao lado de uma construção, martelo e todo tipo de barulho que parecia bater em nossa cabeça. Reclamei e só pediram desculpas, mais nada - terrivel.
2. Tinha 1000 dólares em credito no spa da empresa (part tambem do premio que ganhei pelo meu trabalho duro daria a minha esposa) houve confusao e não consegui usar. Me hospedei novamente 1 dia no hotel, hesitaram em me deixar usar - só soube que poderia usar quando estava de malas feitas e quando não dava mais tempo - esperava uma atitude “deixa que eu resolvo”
3. Minibar nunca é reposto proativamente, tive que pedir 3x, eles simplesmente ignoram - só deu certo quando fui rude. A primeira estadia fiquei 4 dias e o minibar estava vazio, nunca foi reposto.

No fim o saldo é positivo, e eu voltaria mas existe como melhorar mais ainda para deixar a experiência do hospede melhoe.

reviews.text:
We stayed in the adult only reserve ocean front room. The view was amazing. The food was average but initially better than any all inclusive we’ve been to. Our concierge was a huge help in booking our reservations, etc.:   My husband got sick halfway through vacation and was in bed with diarrhea , fever and body aches.  We had the hotel Dr come to our room and prescribe him medication.He was only able to eat saltines the remainder of our trip.
Pretty disappointing when we payed the upgrade for the reserve and couldn’t enjoy the food and drinks the rest of the days. 
If we didn’t get sick and we were able to enjoy the rest, our vacation without any issues I would’ve rated a five star. Unfortunately, I also came home with severe stomach issues. I’m on day six now and all I have to say is make sure to bring your hand sanitizer and watch what you eat.  
 if it looks questionable…..don’t eat it
This was her six visits in DR and our 
last.   We will not be going back.

reviews.text:
Pros:
The property is well maintained and the room is clean. It’s a stunningly beautiful property. The food is very fresh and clearly prepared with care.
Cons:
The hotel management is not good, and it really affected our experience.
1.	We did not receive airport pickup despite filling out their pre-arrival form. When we arrived, our kids had to sleep without pillows the first night because the sofa bed was not made, even though we had requested this in advance.
2.	We had issues at check-in because our room was not available due to a “leak.” We were downgraded to a lesser room for the first night. A “concierge” promised us free spa treatment and water park bracelets as compensation, but it turned out he was actually a sales person trying to get us to buy into their vacation plan (Melia Circle). There were no free spa treatments initially. We had to argue with the front desk for four days in a row just to get them to honor what was promised. It was exhausting and frustrating. Every time we asked to speak to a manager, we had to explain everything again to a new person. I eventually had to call Expedia to file a complaint, and even they could not get in touch with the hotel to resolve the issue.
3.	Do not believe the “free credits” like the $200 resort credit, $50 wine credit, or $100 spa credit listed on your reservation. They look like perks for Expedia guests, but the front desk either doesn’t know about them or refuses to honor them. These are actually tied to their timeshar

reviews.text:
Our recent vacation was nothing short of extraordinary — truly one of the most memorable experiences our family has ever had. From the moment we arrived, every detail was handled with warmth, professionalism, and genuine care. The resort itself was stunning, the atmosphere was welcoming, and every day felt effortless and special.

What elevated this trip from amazing to unforgettable was *** ANA *** our Family Concierge. I can confidently say we have never experienced service at this level before. Every request — big or small — was handled immediately, thoughtfully, and with a smile. Reservations, daily schedules for kids, personalized recommendations, seamless coordination of activities — it was all done flawlessly.

Ana anticipated our needs before we even voiced them and helped me have a special birthday celebration. Ana went above and beyond to accomodate our needs and wants.

Because of this exceptional care, we were able to fully relax, be present with each other, and create memories that will last a lifetime. That level of peace and joy is priceless.

We are beyond grateful and already counting the days until we return. If you’re looking for a vacation experience that combines luxury, warmth, and truly personalized attention — this is it. and Ask for ANA ;) she is truly magnificent and if i could give our vacation a 6-star rating, it would be for Ana  ! 

Thank you Ana and team for giving us memories to cherish a lifetime <3

reviews.text:
First time at this resort. We stayed in the "Reserve" adults only area. We were impressed with the attentiveness of our personal concierge, Yaleidi. She was very helpful with all of our needs and went above and beyond our expectations!
The resort was very clean and felt safe. The food was very good, especially for an "all-inclusive". The restaurants were good, but the Lunch Box buffet was outstanding! We were so surprised at the variety and quality of the food in a buffet!! We also golfed at their affiliated course and had a nice experience there too.
Overall, excellent stay and accommodations!
Our only negative was the weather, it was unseasonably cloudy and rained on/off most of the week we were visiting. It was still warm and a great break from the winter weather in Minnesota!!  Obviously, this has no bearing on the resort. We highly recommend staying here and will be returning!

reviews.text: Our stay at Paradisus Palma Real was truly exceptional and far beyond our expectations. From the moment we arrived, every single employee stood out as professional,  and incredibly helpful. The entire resort was spotless, which made the experience even more enjoyable and relaxing. The pools were always clean and beautiful, with a special mention to The Reserve pools, which were absolutely stunning and peaceful. The room cleaning service did an outstanding job every single day, keeping everything perfectly clean and comfortable. The staff in the restaurants and buffets were excellent as well. The entertainment team at the bar and the recreation areas brought great energy and made every evening fun and memorable. The food was delicious throughout our stay, with a special mention to Dominican Night, which was absolutely amazing and full of flavor. A special shout-out goes to Guillermo, the concierge, for his amazing service and dedication, and to Henler, who was extremely professional and did a fantastic job explaining the Circle membership in a clear and friendly way. Thank you to the entire Paradisus Palma Real team for such an unforgettable experience.With gratitude, My husband Joisys and I, Zairys, TY 4 the outstanding service and for making our stay truly amazing. We would like to give a special mention to Salvador, reservation, what a truly professional, caring person, He genuinely cares about guests, wants you to love DR,representing the hotel at the highest level.
